system.description: When you or an allied creature within 60 feet of you triggers the Swirl effect on a Jutsu with the Wind Release keyword, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge turning the swirling wind into a blazing twister. Increase the radius of the Swirl to a 10-foot radius on the affected creature and all creatures in the area instead gain 1 rank of Immolation.
